tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.class: Social Media as an Educational Tool
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Diaz
professor.text: Many believe that social media platforms, where users exchange information and ideas in virtual communities, have potential for use in education. They can foster collaboration and engagement among students and offer real-time interaction and access to a wide array of resources. However, concerns about misinformation and privacy issues raise questions about their appropriateness in educational settings. What do you think? Can social media be used effectively as a tool for educational purposes? Why or why not?

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: I don't think we should be relying on social media for learning. It can alienate students who lack access to these platforms. Many students simply do not have the luxury of constant internet or social media access, and that could lead to unequal learning opportunities and widen the gap in educational equity.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: Using social media for educational purposes offers the advantage of real-time feedback and communication. It allows students to interact with their instructors outside of regular class times. The learning process could therefore be enhanced through immediate clarification and discussion, making education more dynamic and accessible.
